name: stack-start-interlock
argv:
. "$E/scripts/session_common.sh" || { echo "STOP: the session ssh helpers ($E/scripts/session_common.sh) could not be loaded: NOTHING was run on the guest" >&2; exit 97; }
gssh "$1"

cd /opt/egw/deployment && stat -c '%u:%g %n' data/events && if ls scripts/prepare-broker-secrets.sh scripts/probe-acl.sh >/dev/null && grep -q '3b\.' scripts/validate-config.sh && sh scripts/verify-controller-image.sh /opt/egw/images/egw-controller-0.1.0-arm64.identity.txt && sh scripts/validate-config.sh; then docker compose --env-file .env --env-file images.lock.env up -d; rc=$?; echo "up exit=$rc"; exit $rc; else echo 'STOP: interlock failed - the stack was NOT started'; exit 1; fi

name: collector-copy
argv:
. "$E/scripts/session_common.sh" || { echo "STOP: the session ssh helpers ($E/scripts/session_common.sh) could not be loaded: NOTHING was copied from the guest" >&2; exit 97; }
gscp "$1" "$2"

name: collector-install
argv:
. "$E/scripts/session_common.sh" || { echo "STOP: the session ssh helpers ($E/scripts/session_common.sh) could not be loaded: NOTHING was run on the guest" >&2; exit 97; }
gssh "$1"

set -e
OLDSHA=$(sha256sum /opt/egw/deployment/scripts/collect-resources.sh | cut -d' ' -f1)
COPYSHA=$(sha256sum /tmp/collect-resources.new.sh | cut -d' ' -f1)
[ "$COPYSHA" = "11444c0a21d6f689965d3c3be7c3eca12be132b8bd3a718e105b43d24c4819a6" ] || { echo "STOP: the copied collector is not the clone's ($COPYSHA, expected 11444c0a21d6f689965d3c3be7c3eca12be132b8bd3a718e105b43d24c4819a6)"; exit 1; }
sudo mkdir -p /opt/egw/evidence/collector-previous
sudo cp /opt/egw/deployment/scripts/collect-resources.sh /opt/egw/evidence/collector-previous/collect-resources.$OLDSHA.sh
sudo cp /tmp/collect-resources.new.sh /opt/egw/deployment/scripts/collect-resources.sh
sudo chmod 0755 /opt/egw/deployment/scripts/collect-resources.sh
echo "previous=$OLDSHA"
sha256sum /opt/egw/deployment/scripts/collect-resources.sh
GOTSHA=$(sha256sum /opt/egw/deployment/scripts/collect-resources.sh | cut -d' ' -f1)
[ "$GOTSHA" = "11444c0a21d6f689965d3c3be7c3eca12be132b8bd3a718e105b43d24c4819a6" ] || { echo "STOP: the installed collector is not the clone's ($GOTSHA, expected 11444c0a21d6f689965d3c3be7c3eca12be132b8bd3a718e105b43d24c4819a6)"; exit 1; }

name: deployed-tree-hashes
argv:
. "$E/scripts/session_common.sh" || { echo "STOP: the session ssh helpers ($E/scripts/session_common.sh) could not be loaded: NOTHING was run on the guest" >&2; exit 97; }
gssh "$1"
cd /opt/egw/deployment && sudo find . -type f ! -path './data/*' ! -name .env ! -name passwd ! -path './mosquitto/config/certs/*' -exec sha256sum {} + | sort -k2
